notes: Each record carries the submitted claim, the extraction result the stub returns, and the expected outcome. Claim and extraction are authored independently so they can disagree where a check needs something to catch. expected_checks names only the checks the case is about; unnamed checks are not asserted. must_not are negative assertions that hold regardless of verdict.

records.purpose: Baseline. Everything in order, no exceptions in play.

records.purpose: Over limit, rationale is bare assertion with no ground stated.
